Title: Public preview: SKU recommendation in Azure SQL Migration extension - Azure Data Studio

Body.Content: Support for SKU recommendation in the Azure SQL Migration extension for Azure Data Studio is in public preview. The SKU recommendation feature can evaluate the source SQL Server performance and utilization characteristics to recommend a right-sized Azure SQL Managed Instance or SQL Server on Azure Virtual Machines to assist with your migration journey. Additionally, you can import data that was collected for a SKU recommendation with Data Migration Assistant.
